components.name: License Plate
components.description: The vehicle's plate: the only headline of the driver home screen.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; height: 96px; overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid #111111; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #ffffff, inset 0 0 0 5px #111111, 0 2px 6px rgba(17,17,17,0.12); } .ds-plate-band { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; width: 48px; padding-bottom: 10px; background: #1f4fb4; color: #ffffff; font: 700 16px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-plate-num { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0; white-space: nowrap; color: #111111; font: 700 clamp(2.5rem, 13vw, 3.75rem)/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-plate-prov { align-self: flex-end; margin: 0 0 20px 8px; font-size: 0.5em; }

components.name: Today Vignette
components.description: Yellow sticker panel with today's versement status and the main action.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-vignette { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #f2c230; color: #111111; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; animation: ds-stick 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-vignette-title { margin: 0; font: 700 34px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-vignette-text { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-vignette .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1f4fb4; color: #ffffff; font: 700 17px/1.375 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-vignette .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #173d8c; } .ds-text-link { padding: 8px 0; text-align: center; color: #111111; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-vignette a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f4fb4; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-stick { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-1.2deg) scale(0.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-vignette { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The driver's space is built as a Congolese license plate read in full sun. The vehicle is its plate: a white, double-framed plate with a blue "CGO" band is the only headline on the home screen, and today's versement sits under it as a yellow vignette, the sticker you would glue to a windscreen. Everything else is printed in ink-black on a reflective off-white ground, in a condensed plate face for numbers and headings and a plain street face for reading. The world is flat, high-contrast and literal: kilometres, amounts and statuses are shown plainly, never inside glowing KPI tiles.

Density is low and vertical. One column, one hand, big targets (52-56px controls), and history laid out as rows at a single shared scale so days compare at a glance. State is carried by four fixed markers (filled dot, ring, diamond, dashed ring) that mean the same thing on every screen, always paired with a French word ("Validé", "En attente de validation", "Rejeté", "Rien déclaré"). The voice is plain Kinshasa French addressed to the driver: "Mbote, Patrick", "Déclarer mon versement", "Notez le compteur avant de rendre le véhicule."

The direction explicitly refuses the dark fintech dashboard with glowing KPI cards and icon tiles, and it must not feel folkloric: the plate is a real, everyday object, not a flag or a pattern.

Scope: this world is applied to the driver space only (/driver/*). The investor and admin spaces still run the incumbent dark look, which is legacy, not the system; new surfaces and any future redesign of those spaces extend the plate world.
keyCharacteristics: The plate is the hero and the identity; no logo, no "Portail chauffeur" title.
Two inks for reading: plate ink on light grounds, plate white on the blue band and on filled ink buttons.
Blue means "the plate, the main action, and where you are".
One fixed marker per state, everywhere, always with a word.
Flat surfaces, 2px borders, rows instead of cards for history.
Condensed numerals with tabular figures for every amount.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Readable text is plate ink, or plate white on band blue and filled ink. Road Soft is the only allowed secondary ink; no lighter greys, no colored body text outside notices.

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: Blue is the plate band, the one main action per view, and "you are here" (active nav, focus). It is never a decorative fill, a heading color or a chart color.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: Yellow belongs to today's versement panel and to reporting a breakdown. A second yellow surface on the same screen is wrong; the "Démarrer la réparation" button is deliberately turned white for this reason.

rules.name: The Plate Face Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is for the plate, headings and numbers. Sentences and labels are always Barlow.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at normal tracking; the plate world resets the legacy uppercase, letter-spaced section labels. Nothing below 13px.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Days in history are rows sharing one scale: the maximum of the daily target and the largest day. Each row is a 64px day label, a 12px bar on a rule-colored track, and the right-aligned figure, with the state marker and word indented 76px underneath. Never per-day cards, never per-row scaling.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Only the plate has a frame shadow. Everything else separates with a 2px border or a ground change.

dos: Do make the plate the first and largest thing on a vehicle screen, with the CGO band in Plate Band Blue.
Do write every readable word in plate ink (#111111) or plate white on blue/ink; use Road Soft (#3b3b36) only for sub-lines.
Do show every payment, vehicle and breakdown state with its fixed marker (dot, ring, diamond, dashed ring) and its French word.
Do compare days as rows on one shared scale, with condensed tabular figures right-aligned.
Do keep touch targets at 52px minimum (56px for the primary action) and text at 13px minimum.
Do separate surfaces with 2px borders and ground changes, not shadows.
Do keep one primary blue action per view and reserve yellow for today's vignette and breakdown reporting.
Do extend this world, not the legacy dark look, when building new screens or redesigning the investor and admin spaces.
donts: Don't build dark fintech dashboards with glowing KPI cards, icon tiles, gradients or blur.
Don't add a page title or decorative badge above the plate on the home screen; the plate is the headline.
Don't use blue for headings, charts or decoration, or yellow for anything other than today and the breakdown report.
Don't use pale grey text, uppercase tracked labels, or text below 13px.
Don't invent new state colors or shapes, or show a state by color alone.
Don't give history entries their own cards or their own scales.
Don't make it folkloric: the plate, a real everyday object, is the world's only local reference; add no decorative motifs around it.
